oracle_note: Grader-only dimension-7 oracle. Lives in the eval's grader-only `oracle/` dir — outside `test-files/` — so neither `files[]` listing nor whole-directory staging can leak it to the model under test. Extracted claim ids `Cn` are matched to expected entries `Vn` by asserted content, not by id number. Legitimate unseeded findings (e.g. extra observations about the slice) are ungraded — neither required nor penalized; only the entries below and the Check C finding are graded.
